1.w: Give thanks to YHWH; call on His name; make known among the nations His deeds!

2.w: Sing to Him, make music to Him; meditate on all His wonders!

3.w: Glory in the name of His holiness; let the heart of those seeking YHWH rejoice!

4.w: Search after YHWH and His strength; seek His face continually.

5.w: Remember His wonders that He has done—His wonders and the judgments of His mouth—

6.w: O seed of Abraham His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones!

7.w: He [is] YHWH our God; His judgments [are] over all the earth.

8.w: He remembers His covenant forever—the word He commanded for a thousand generations—

9.w: that which He cut with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac.

10.w: And He established it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel [as] a covenant forever,

11.w: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the portion of your⁺ inheritance.”

12.w: In their being few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

13.w: and they went about from nation to nation, from a kingdom to another people.

14.w: He has permitted no man to oppress them, and He rebuked kings for them:

15.w: “You⁺ shall not touch My anointed ones, and to My prophets You⁺ shall not do evil.”

16.w: And He called down famine on the land; the whole staff of bread He has broken.

17.w: He sent before them a man, [to] be sold as a slave—Joseph.

18.w: They afflicted his feet with the fetters; [into] iron came his neck,

19.w: until the time of the coming of His word—the word of YHWH tried him.

20.w: The king sent and released him, and the ruler of the peoples drew him out.

21.w: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance,

22.w: to instruct his princes by his soul, and his elders to make wise.

23.w: And Israel came to Egypt, and Jacob resided in the land of Ham.

24.w: And His people He made exceedingly fruitful, and made them mightier than their enemies.

25.w: He turned their heart to hate His people, to act deceitfully with His servants.

26.w: He sent Moses His servant, Aaron whom He had chosen.

27.w: They set among them the words of His signs, and wonders in the land of Ham.

28.w: He sent darkness and it became dark, and they defied His words.

29.w: He turned their waters to blood, and He put to death their fish.

30.w: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the inner chambers of their kings.

31.w: He spoke, and the swarm came, gnats in all their country.

32.w: He gave hail for rain, flames of fire in their land.

33.w: And He struck their vines and their fig trees, and He shattered the trees of their country.

34.w: He spoke, and the locust came, and the young locust without number,

35.w: and it ate up every herb in their land, and it devoured the fruit of their ground.

36.w: And He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.

37.w: And He brought them out with silver and gold, and there were none among His tribes stumbling.

38.w: Egypt was glad at their going out, for the dread of them had fallen upon them.

39.w: He spread a cloud for a screen, and fire to light up the night.

40.w: They asked, and He brought quail, and with the bread of the heavens He satisfied them.

41.w: He opened the rock, and waters gushed from it; they went forth in the desert like a river.

42.w: For He remembered the word of His holiness to Abraham His servant.

43.w: And He brought out His people with rejoicing, [and] His chosen with a shout of joy.

44.w: And He gave to them the lands of the nations, and they possessed the labor of the peoples,

45.w: that they may keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelu YAH!
